library.description: The Chinese source article is saved first. Translation, vocabulary, grammar, and questions are separate AI learning support that can be added later.

tabs.aria: Daily Reading library and activity history

status.todayDue: Capture time passed; waiting for the task

activity.title: Activity history
activity.description: The actual log of source captures and AI learning-support runs on this device, newest first.
activity.emptyDescription: When Daily Reading captures an article or creates learning support, its status and time will appear here.

settings.title: Daily Reading
settings.description: Configure how HanziHome captures source articles and adds optional AI support. Status, library, and task history live in the Daily Reading workspace.

capture.title: Source article
capture.description: Choose when and what kind of article HanziHome should find. A saved article counts as complete even when AI support is not ready yet.
capture.autoTitle: Find one article automatically each day
capture.autoDescription: At the selected time the app finds a new article; if the app is closed, it catches up on the next open.
capture.levelDescription: Guides learning support only; it never rewrites the Chinese source article.
capture.todayDue: Capture time has passed; waiting to find an article
capture.sourceIndependent: Source testing only checks discovery and extraction; it does not use an AI API key.

sourcePreview.title: Latest source test
sourcePreview.notPersisted: This is only a source test. The article has not been added to the library.

ai.title: AI learning support
ai.description: AI creates Vietnamese translation, vocabulary, grammar, and questions after the source article has already been saved.
ai.autoTitle: Automatically add learning support after capture
ai.autoDescription: When a usable API key exists, the app creates missing learning modules after saving the article. AI failure never makes the source article fail.
ai.missing: No AI API key yet. Source articles can still be found and read normally.
ai.storageUnavailable: Secure server-side API key storage is not ready. Source article capture is unaffected.
ai.credentialUnreadable: A saved key cannot currently be read. You can add a replacement key without affecting source articles.
ai.articleIndependent: Source capture and AI are independent states: the article succeeds first, and learning support can be added or retried later.

advanced.title: Advanced sources and criteria
advanced.description: Adjust these only when you want tighter control over sources, freshness, length, or topic diversity.
advanced.freshnessDescription: First consider only articles published within this window.
advanced.diversityDescription: Reduce the chance of repeating topics read recently.
advanced.avoidRecentDescription: Exclude URLs already present in the local library from the next search.
advanced.topicsDescription: Select at least one topic. The app still applies its safety content policy.
advanced.sourcesDescription: Search only the reviewed publisher allowlist.
advanced.atLeastOneTopic: Keep at least one topic selected.
advanced.atLeastOneSource: Keep at least one source selected.

toast.sourceFailed: Could not test sources with the current criteria.
toast.captureFailed: Could not find a new source article.
toast.settingFailed: Could not save Daily Reading settings on this device.

enrichment.title: AI learning support
enrichment.description: The Chinese text above always remains the saved source article. These modules only add meanings and exercises; they never rewrite the source.
enrichment.runtimeMissing: No AI API key yet. You can still read the complete source article.
enrichment.runtimeStorageUnavailable: Server-side API key storage is not ready; the source article remains fully readable.
enrichment.runtimeCheckFailed: AI status could not be checked right now. The source article remains readable; try the status check again.

translation.title: Vietnamese translation
translation.description: Translate each saved paragraph closely while preserving paragraph IDs.

vocabulary.title: Article vocabulary
vocabulary.description: Only words and phrases that actually occur in the source article are accepted.

grammar.title: Grammar with evidence
grammar.description: Every grammar point must include a complete sentence from the source article.

questions.title: Reading questions
questions.description: Questions and answers must point back to specific source paragraphs.

toast.allReady: All learning support modules are ready.
